title: helianthemum papillare var. pediforme
intro: Helianthemum papillare var. pediforme, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species native to certain regions of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional herbal medicine to treat various health issues. Rockrose is known to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, providing relief from pain and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
